name: Talude Studio V3 — Modular Classificação + MDT + Duplo Motor

checks.name: Python 3.12
checks.hint: O Local Build Manager gere automaticamente um Python 3.12 privado.

checks.name: Git
checks.command: if (Test-Path '.git') { git --version } else { Write-Output 'Git opcional: pasta ZIP sem .git; BUILD/TESTES funcionam sem Git'; exit 0 }
checks.hint: Opcional em pastas ZIP; necessário apenas para Git Pull/clones.

test.name: Verificar espaço livre antes de instalar dependências
Compilar motor + Studio
test.command: & '%PYTHON%' -m compileall -q src studio core ALGORITM tests talude_gui.py talude_studio.py

build.name: Verificar espaço livre antes de BUILD + TESTES
Validar motor e Studio antes do EXE
Preparar pasta de build
build.command: if (Test-Path '%WORK%') { Remove-Item '%WORK%' -Recurse -Force }; $short=Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'LBM\TaludeStudioV3Build'; if (Test-Path $short) { Remove-Item $short -Recurse -Force }; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path '%WORK%', '%LATEST%', '%ARCHIVE%' | Out-Null

build.name: Verificar Talude_V3.exe
build.command: $exe=Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'LBM\TaludeStudioV3Build\dist\Talude_V3\Talude_V3.exe'; if (!(Test-Path $exe)) { throw ('Talude_V3.exe não foi gerado: ' + $exe) }; Get-Item $exe | Select-Object FullName,Length,LastWriteTime

build.name: Self-test QtWebEngine + Potree + motor
build.command: $dist=Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'LBM\TaludeStudioV3Build\dist\Talude_V3'; Push-Location $dist; try { Remove-Item TALUDE_V1_SELF_TEST.txt -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; & ./Talude_V3.exe --self-test; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; if (!(Test-Path './TALUDE_V1_SELF_TEST.txt')) { throw 'Self-test não criou relatório' }; Get-Content ./TALUDE_V1_SELF_TEST.txt } finally { Pop-Location }

build.name: Preparar Talude Studio portátil
build.command: $root=Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'LBM\TaludeStudioV3Build'; $pkg=Join-Path $root 'package'; $dist=Join-Path $root 'dist\Talude_V3'; if (Test-Path $pkg) { Remove-Item $pkg -Recurse -Force }; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $pkg | Out-Null; Copy-Item -Recurse $dist (Join-Path $pkg 'Talude_V3'); Copy-Item -Force 'packaging/START_TALUDE_V3.bat' $pkg; Copy-Item -Force 'packaging/LEIA_ME.txt' $pkg; Copy-Item -Force 'README.md' $pkg; Copy-Item -Recurse -Force 'ALGORITM' (Join-Path $pkg 'ALGORITM'); Copy-Item -Force 'README_V3.md' $pkg; Copy-Item -Force 'KNOWN_ISSUES.md' $pkg

build.name: Validar ZIP V3 extraído em pasta independente
build.command: $zip='%LATEST%/Talude_V3_Windows_x64.zip'; $temp=Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'LBM\\TaludeV3Verify'; if (Test-Path $temp) { Remove-Item -Force -Recurse $temp }; Expand-Archive -LiteralPath $zip -DestinationPath $temp -Force; foreach ($f in @('ALGORITM\\CLASSIFY\\classify_las_algorithm.py','ALGORITM\\TALUDE_AUTO\\TALUDE_AUTO.py','Talude_V3\\Talude_V3.exe')) { if (!(Test-Path (Join-Path $temp $f))) { throw ('ZIP incompleto: '+$f) } }; Push-Location (Join-Path $temp 'Talude_V3'); try { & '.\\Talude_V3.exe' --self-test; $selftest_exit=$LASTEXITCODE; $diag=Join-Path (Get-Location).Path 'TALUDE_V1_SELF_TEST.txt'; if (Test-Path $diag) { Write-Output '=== RELATORIO DO EXE EXTRAIDO ==='; Get-Content -LiteralPath $diag; Copy-Item -LiteralPath $diag -Destination '%LATEST%/V3_POST_EXTRACT_SELF_TEST.txt' -Force } else { Write-Output '[ERRO] EXE nao gerou ficheiro de self-test; consultar %LOCALAPPDATA%/Talude_V1/logs/TALUDE_STUDIO_RUNTIME.log' }; if ($selftest_exit -ne 0) { throw ('Self-test V3 pos-extracao falhou (exit='+$selftest_exit+'). Ver diagnostico acima.') }; if (!(Test-Path '.\\TALUDE_V1_SELF_TEST.txt')) { throw 'Relatorio self-test nao criado.' } } finally { Pop-Location }; Write-Output 'ZIP V3 extraido e self-test validado em diretorio independente.'
